title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 15): Mole Model
summary: Part 15 of NH's mocking series about YouTuber Jason Blaha. It covers what NH calls sock-puppet comments, coaching clients who dropped Blaha, and a long ridicule of Blaha's claims about his dating life. The promised private-message segment is not in the transcript, which goes junk after about 34 minutes.
claims: NH says he relies on a group of about 15 volunteers who send him information for the series
NH reports that the coaching clients Joey Fazer and 'Mikey' stopped working with Blaha, which NH says he had predicted
NH says he won't release his sources or screenshots publicly, to protect his informants
NH says many MGTOW men are just men who chose partners poorly, got hurt, and now blame women
NH ridicules Blaha's story about insisting on sugar-free jello shots to protect his abs
As a rule, the men who talk most about their sexual conquests have the fewest
